commands.name: mail.search
commands.description: Search the person's Gmail with Gmail's own search words, e.g. "from:ravi is:unread", "subject:invoice newer_than:7d". Returns message ids, senders, subjects, dates and snippets, newest first. Needs Gmail connected in Mail. Never marks mail read.

query.description: Gmail search words; leave out for the inbox

commands.name: mail.read
commands.description: Read one Gmail message by the id that mail.search or mail.unread gave: its thread id, the mailbox's own address (me), sender, recipients, subject, date, plain text (up to 20,000 characters), attachment names, and the dated promises found in it by Emergic's rules. Never marks mail read.

commands.name: mail.unread
commands.description: How many unread messages are in the person's Gmail inbox, and the newest of them. Needs Gmail connected in Mail.

max.description: How many unread messages to list, 1 to 25 (default 10)

commands.name: mail.triage
commands.description: Sort inbox messages into reply, read, later or skip with the person's AI model, each with a short reason. Uses Gmail's search words like mail.search. Changes nothing in Gmail and never marks mail read. Needs an AI model set up in NakliOS.

query.description: Gmail search words; leave out for the inbox

commands.name: mail.draft
commands.description: Write a reply to one message and save it in the person's Gmail Drafts. Give the body, or leave it out and the person's AI model drafts it from the instruction. Never sends; mail.send sends the draft after the person confirms.

id.description: The message id from mail.search, mail.unread or mail.triage

body.description: The reply text; leave out to have the AI model draft it

instruction.description: What the reply should say, for the AI draft

commands.name: mail.forward
commands.description: Forward one message to someone: saves a draft with the original quoted below an optional note, in the person's Gmail Drafts. Attachments are not forwarded. Never sends; mail.send sends the draft after the person confirms.

id.description: The message id from mail.search, mail.unread or mail.triage

to.description: Who to forward it to (email address)

note.description: A note above the forwarded message

commands.name: mail.send
commands.description: Send a draft saved by mail.draft or mail.forward. The desktop shows the person the recipient and subject and asks every time; the draft must still go to that recipient with that subject, or nothing is sent.

draftId.description: The draftId from mail.draft or mail.forward

to.description: The recipient the draft goes to

commands.name: mail.archive
commands.description: Take one message out of the inbox; it stays in All Mail. With undo, put it back in the inbox.

id.description: The message id from mail.search, mail.unread or mail.triage

undo.description: Put it back in the inbox

commands.name: mail.trash
commands.description: Move one message to Gmail's Trash, which Gmail empties after 30 days. With undo, bring it back from Trash.

id.description: The message id from mail.search, mail.unread or mail.triage

parity.google: person: connecting a Google account needs the person's own sign-in and consent
